<b>Choir Pouncers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Pilgrim Pouncer]]s who have become part of [[the Choir]], bearing a cleaner, decorated white robe.<ref>Choir Pouncer [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Agile bug, and one of few hardy pilgrims to have reached the Citadel."</i></ref>
== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Choir Pouncers behave identically to their Pilgrim counterparts, leaping at Hornet and rolling as they land if she approaches.

Choir Pouncers deal {{Damage|1}} both on contact and with their attack.

Basic outspacing is all that is required to defeat them.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* To live eternal... in the light...
* I am chosen!
* Your ringing halls...
* Your shining walls...
* The song...
* Where is the song?
* When may I rest?
* Is this the way?
* None shall starve...
* None shall die...
}}

== Location ==
Choir Pouncers are primariy found throughout the [[Choral Chambers]]. They also appear during enemy gauntlet at the entrance to [[Whispering Vaults]], accessible from [[Cogwork Core]].
